newMessage.title: New Message
newMessage.description: Enter the recipient's phone number and your message below, and we'll deliver a real SMS it through your connected Android phone. You can also text a short code like 24273 without entering a full phone number.

bulkMessages.title: Bulk Messages
bulkMessages.description: Fill in our bulk SMS CSV template or our Excel template and upload it here to send your SMS messages to multiple recipients at once. You can also configure send schedules on your phone to make sure messages are sent out at specific times of the day e.g Mon - Fri 9am - 5pm.
bulkMessages.historyDesc: Your 10 most recent bulk SMS uploads are shown below, including a delivery status breakdown for each batch. Click on a row to see individual messages on the search page.
bulkMessages.historyFetchError: Error while fetching bulk messages history

searchMessages.title: Search Messages
searchMessages.description: On this page, you can search all your messages by phone number, message type, and message status and even using the content of the SMS message. You will also be able to bulk delete messages and even export your messages in a CSV file.
searchMessages.deleteConfirmDesc: The messages will be deleted permanently from the httpSMS server and cannot be recovered.
searchMessages.resendConfirmDesc: The selected messages will be queued for sending again using the original sender, recipient, and content.
searchMessages.exportSuccess: The selected messages have been exported successfully
searchMessages.deleteSuccess: The selected messages have been deleted successfully
searchMessages.deleteError: Error while deleting the selected messages
searchMessages.resendSuccess: The selected messages have been queued for resending
searchMessages.resendError: Error while resending the selected messages
searchMessages.searchError: Error while searching messages. Contact us via email

phoneApiKeys.title: Phone API Keys
phoneApiKeys.description: If you have multiple phones, you can create unique phone API keys for your different Android phones. These API keys can only be used on the specific mobile phone when it calls the httpSMS server for specific actions like sending heartbeats, registering received messages, delivery reports etc. If you want to interact with the full httpSMS API, use the API key under your account settings page instead {url}.
phoneApiKeys.createSubtitle: After creating the API key you can use it to login to the httpSMS Android app on your phone
phoneApiKeys.namePlaceholder: Enter a name for your phone API key
phoneApiKeys.qrSubtitle: Scan this QR code with the httpSMS app on your Android phone to login.
phoneApiKeys.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete the phone API Key?
phoneApiKeys.deleteConfirmDesc: You will have to logout and login again on the httpSMS Android app on all of the phones which are currently using this API key.
phoneApiKeys.removePhoneTitle: Are you sure you want to remove this phone number from the Phone API Key?
phoneApiKeys.removePhoneDesc: This will remove the {phone} from your phone API key. You will have to logout and login again on the httpSMS Android app on the phone which is currently using this API key.

settings.verificationEmailSent: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.

settings.rotateApiKeyConfirm: Are you sure you want to rotate your API Key?
settings.rotateApiKeyDesc: You will have to logout and login again on the {app} Android app with your new API key after you rotate it.
settings.webhooksDesc: Webhooks allow us to send events to your server for example when the android phone receives an SMS message we can forward the message to your server.
settings.webhookCallbackHint: A POST request will be sent to this URL every time an event is triggered in httpSMS.
settings.webhookSigningKeyHint: The signing key is used to verify the webhook is sent from httpSMS.
settings.webhookEventsHint: Select multiple httpSMS events to watch for
settings.webhookPhonesHint: Select multiple phone numbers to watch for events
settings.discordDesc: Send and receive SMS messages without leaving your discord server with the httpSMS discord app using the {code} command.
settings.discordBotDesc: Click the button below to add the httpSMS bot to your discord server. You need to do this so we can have permission to send and receive messages on your discord server.
settings.discordServerIdHint: You can get this by right clicking on your server and clicking Copy Server ID.
settings.discordChannelIdHint: You can get this by right clicking on your discord channel and clicking Copy Channel ID.
settings.phonesDesc: List of mobile phones which are registered for sending and receiving SMS messages.
settings.sendSchedulesDesc: Create availability schedules and attach them to each phone. Outgoing messages sent outside the schedule window are queued and delivered when the schedule opens according to your {link}.
settings.emailNotificationsDesc: Manage the email notifications which you receive from httpSMS. Feel free to turn on/off individual notifications anytime so you don't get overloaded with emails
settings.heartbeatEmailsHint: This switch controls email notifications we send when we don't receive a heartbeat from your phone for 1 hour.
settings.webhookEmailsHint: This switch controls email notifications we send when we can't forward events to your discord server or to your webhook.
settings.messageStatusEmailsHint: This switch controls email notifications we send when your message is failed or expired.
settings.newsletterEmailsHint: This switch controls newsletter emails about new features, updates, and promotions.
settings.dataRetentionDesc: Your messages are permanently deleted once they exceed the max retention period below, counted from when the message was sent or received. You can always delete your messages manually on the {link}.
settings.deleteAccountActiveSub: You cannot delete your account because you have an active subscription on httpSMS. {link} before deleting your account.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: You can delete all your data on httpSMS by clicking the button below. This action is {irreversible} and all your data will be permanently deleted from the httpSMS database instantly and it cannot be recovered.
settings.deleteAccountConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action is {irreversible} and all your data will be permanently deleted from the httpSMS database instantly.
